theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (χ : Euclidean N → ℝ), Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → ∃ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ (z : Euclidean N) (S : Grassmannian N n), f (z, S) = χ z * ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖) ∧ tsupport f ⊆ tsupport χ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))
